facts.text: Oldham rose to prominence in the 19th century as an international centre of textile manufacture.
The former Oldham Loop Line was converted into the Oldham and Rochdale Line of the Metrolink light rail network.
Oldham Parish Church stands as a historic landmark, reflecting centuries of architectural beauty and spiritual significance within the town.
The Spindles shopping centre, named after textile spindles, hosts over 40 retailers and reflects the town's industrial heritage.
Oldham Athletic Association Football Club, known as The Latics, was founded in 1895 as Pine Villa Football Club.
Oldham was first mentioned as a permanent settlement in 865 when Danish invaders established a settlement called Aldehulme.
